subject.title: fix: stretch identity slot roots to prevent absolute-only collapse

question: Should the identity slot's public default remain centered for widthless roots, or should all identity slot roots stretch to the full cell width?
rationale: The proposed CSS resolves absolute-only artwork but deliberately changes the rendered default for existing custom slot roots, and the repository treats documented hooks as public API.

options.title: Retain centered default
options.body: Keep the legacy centered layout and require or provide an explicit opt-in for full-width absolute-only artwork.

options.title: Adopt stretch as the contract
options.body: Accept full-width stretching for all custom identity slot roots and add upgrade-facing coverage and proof for that visual change.

recommendation.title: Retain centered default
recommendation.body: Keep the legacy centered layout and require or provide an explicit opt-in for full-width absolute-only artwork.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy and the Project Record contract reserve the merge decision for Bobby.
